grammar.summary: 本课学习将来完成进行时与预测表达。

points.title: 将来完成时 will have done
points.explanation: By the end of next year, they will have finished the work on the new stadium. by + 将来时间 = 标志词。

examples.en: By the end of next year, they will have completed the project.
examples.cn: 到明年年底，他们将完成该项目。

points.title: 表预测的多样句型
points.explanation: will be able to / will be doing 表将来的不同侧面：能力未来、过程未来。

examples.en: The whole village will be able to watch the match.
